subject: Trans Sumatra operational km
value_a: 982 km built and operational (Hutama Karya, 4 Oct 2026)
value_b: 1,051.84 km Phase I operational (Bina Marga, 3 Aug 2026)
resolution: Atlas publishes 982 km as the current operational figure. The 1,051.84 km Phase I figure is a different scope and date and stays in the corridor notes.
notes: The two figures describe different reporting windows and Phase I boundaries.

subject: Trans Sumatra segment-table coverage
value_a: 13 sections totalling 1,667.31 km of the 2,854 km plan
resolution: The segment table is explicitly partial; no percentage is calculated from it. The 982 km corridor total is wider than the operational length inside the 13 listed sections.
notes: Partial section lists and aggregate operational totals are not the same reference set.

subject: Trans Java total km
value_a: 1,232.78 km printed in the January 2025 article
value_b: 1,232.80 km sum of the 20 section lengths
resolution: Atlas uses 1,232.80 km, the section sum, and records the 0.02 km rounding difference.
notes: Both figures come from the same BPJT section list.

subject: Trans Java operating km
value_a: 1,167 km in older PU and Wikipedia figures
value_b: 1,079.895 km atlas composite as of 7 Sep 2026
resolution: Atlas uses the dated composite: 1,056.38 km across 20 sections by January 2025 plus 23.515 km Gending-Paiton opened 7 September 2026.
notes: Older figures use different dates and corridor definitions.

subject: Paiton-Besuki section length
resolution: Atlas records 26.185 km in the segment table and flags the 0.585 km discrepancy. The corridor total stays 1,232.80 km.
notes: The printed section length does not reconcile with the parent total and the opened sub-section.

subject: Trans Sulawesi total km
resolution: Atlas publishes 2,000 km for the defined Manado-Makassar corridor and explicitly withholds a progress percentage.
notes: The 3,900 km figure is a different network scope, not a competing corridor length.

subject: Trans Kalimantan definition and total
value_a: 3,901 km southern route from Aruk to Malinau
value_b: 1,186 km travel route; 1,920 km border-parallel road; 2,100.8 km WPS figure
resolution: Atlas uses the 3,901 km southern route, lists the competing definitions and publishes no operational-km series.
notes: One document reports all competing figures; none is a dated operational series.

subject: Trans Papua total versus connected and paved km
value_b: 3,446 km connected; 2,235 km paved; 1,132 km still soil (Nov 2025)
resolution: Atlas publishes the 4,330 km route total and the eight Papua-side segment lengths. Connected and paved are kept as separate metrics, not treated as operational km.
notes: No single dated operational series covers the whole corridor.

subject: Binjai-Langsa status
value_b: 73.7 km of 130.9 km not open; Indonesian Wikipedia marks it partly open
resolution: Atlas keeps under_construction because 57.23 km of 130.9 km is operational. The BPJT label and the open length are both recorded.
notes: BPJT applies Operasi to corridors with an open section.

subject: Kayu Agung-Palembang-Betung length and rows
value_b: BPJT lists Kayuagung-Palembang at 37.62 of 42.5 km; Palembang-Betung is a separate BPJT row
resolution: Atlas keeps the combined corridor row with the Wikipedia length and records the BPJT split. Palembang-Betung is not double-counted.
notes: The BPJT API splits the corridor while the atlas treats it as one asset.

subject: Demak-Tuban operator
resolution: Atlas leaves the operator unset. No BPJT row exists for this planned corridor, and neither Wikipedia value is an official operator appointment.
notes: English Wikipedia lists the operator as tba (to be announced). The Indonesian Wikipedia revision names PT. HM Sampoerna Tbk, a tobacco company with no known toll-road role; this looks like a table editing error, but it is recorded rather than silently discarded.

subject: Cilacap-Yogyakarta length
resolution: Atlas keeps 167.07 km pending a BPJT or other official source. Both figures remain in the notes.
notes: No official source found for the planned corridor.

subject: Solo-Yogyakarta corridor definition
value_a: BPJT treats it as one 96.57 km corridor
value_b: Wikipedia splits Yogyakarta-Solo 58.01 km and Yogyakarta-Sleman-YIA 35.74 km
resolution: Atlas follows the BPJT one-corridor definition and records the split in the row notes.
notes: The two definitions produce different operational shares.

subject: Industrial-estate count
value_b: 160 industrial-estate designations in the 2024 BAJRA mirror
resolution: Atlas keeps 160 rows and publishes a 19-name gap ledger. No rows are invented to close the gap.
notes: The 2026 count is a benchmark; the row-level list is a 2024 snapshot.

subject: Makassar-Parepare status
value_a: Deck summary reports construction 100% and the project complete
value_b: Project page reports Mandai-Palanro at 95.91% with the Tonasa land issue continuing in 2025
resolution: Atlas keeps operating with the partial-section caveat in status_basis and notes.
notes: The summary and the project page use different completion definitions.

subject: East Kalimantan railway target year
resolution: Atlas uses the 2028 target and keeps the 2027 reference in the row notes.
notes: The two pages of the same deck disagree.

subject: Freeport Manyar cathode capacity
value_b: 600-650 ktpa elsewhere; PTFI describes a 2 Mtpa concentrate feed design
resolution: Atlas records the design feed capacity and notes the cathode range. It does not choose a cathode output figure.
notes: Cathode output, design feed and ramp-up figures are different measures.

subject: Patimban status
value_a: Summary lists Patimban among 29 completed projects
value_b: Project page reports Phase I-2 packages 5 and 6 at 95.48% and 93.02% in late 2025
resolution: Atlas keeps under_construction because Phase I-2 is still active; Phase I opened in 2021.
notes: Project-level completion and phase completion differ.

subject: Benoa expansion opening date
value_a: All listed BMTH works reported 100% in 2025
value_b: No exact opening date is stated in the deck
resolution: Atlas marks recently_completed with opened_year 2025 but leaves opened_date blank.
notes: An exact dated opening source is still needed.
